# runzero_asset_ownership_type (Resource)

Manages a RunZero asset ownership type.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the asset ownership type.

### Optional

- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the ownership type is hidden.
- `order` (Number) Display order for the ownership type.
- `reference` (Number) Reference number for the ownership type.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the asset ownership type.
